title: digit.accounts v1: the DIGIT accounts a person holds, mirrored from DIGIT into Keycloak
description: Single-valued Keycloak user attribute holding this JSON. Written only by the BFF sync module (DIGIT -> Keycloak mirror) and the credential writer (credential.keyVersion). It never authorizes anything on its own: the binding state lives in digit.bindings.

mirroredAt.description: Epoch ms of the last successful mirror for this person

tenantId.description: A plain tenant id (D16: no sub-tenants)

roleTenantId.description: Copied from egov-user as is; legacy data may hold a dotted city tenant

tenantId.description: The DIGIT account's tenant (egov-user tenantId). For staff, the binding tenant

boundAt.description: Epoch ms the account was first bound or linked. Never rewritten. Orders entries for D12

userName.description: DIGIT userName (immutable in egov-user). Lets revocation sign in without a search

name.description: Staff only: the whole DIGIT name of this tenant's account, as last mirrored (never a masked value). The tenant member list reads it instead of the person-wide firstName

missing.description: Present only when the DIGIT account has disappeared (design 4). The entry stays; it is never silently dropped

credential.description: Staff only. Absent until the derived credential is first set (design 6)

setAt.description: Epoch ms the derived password was last written to egov-user
